Product Features

  • Precise dimensions of 175 x 39.5 x 53 cm, a flat design that doesn't feel oppressive, and harmonious proportions that blend seamlessly into various living rooms. Simple and elegant lines enhance the room and create a comfortable viewing experience.
  • Suitable for TVs up to 70 inches, but also easily accommodates larger screens. Generous ventilation openings on the underside ensure stable operation and meet the requirements of modern home theater systems.
  • A well-designed compartment layout with double cabinets and open shelves. The closed cabinets are dust- and moisture-protected, while the open shelves allow easy access to your belongings. Categorize and store audio and video equipment, books, and decorative items, creating order and a tidy space.
  • Made from selected, environmentally friendly chipboard, the construction is robust and dimensionally stable. The smooth, durable, and easy-to-clean surface offers excellent protection against water and moisture. Environmentally friendly, odorless, and therefore healthy for your family.
  • With an extremely high load capacity of up to 45 kg, this cabinet provides secure support for large-screen TVs and heavy appliances. The weight is evenly distributed, preventing wobbling. Thanks to its reliable construction, it remains safe and stable even after extended use.
  • Equipped with quiet, dampened hinges, the door closes automatically and gently, effectively preventing impacts and noise. The soft closing mechanism protects the cabinet, and the anti-pinch protection ensures greater safety and convenience.
  • Integrated, adjustable shelves allow for flexible height adjustment and provide space for items of different heights, whether set-top boxes or storage boxes.
  • This multifunctional design serves as both a professional TV control panel and a practical living room cabinet, combining storage, display, and organization. It is versatile and offers excellent value for money.
  • It complements various interior design styles, including modern, minimalist, and Scandinavian. Its freestanding design eliminates the need for wall mounting, simplifying installation and effortlessly enhancing the style of your living room, creating your ideal living environment.
  • Note: Due to varying shooting conditions and display devices, slight color variations may occur between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to represent the product color as accurately as possible. Please only order if color accuracy is important to you.
